description: Places an ad order. With an API key whose balance covers the price, it is paid from the balance. Otherwise the result is isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object for the exact price: sign it and call this tool again with the same order and the payment (in _meta["x402/payment"], or as payment_signature). Without an API key the paid result carries api_key, the key of the new account that owns the ad: store it, it is shown once. The ad goes to review; poll get_ad. (The ad of an account the network has marked as trusted is active in this answer.)

api_key.description: The API key of the account (can_live_...). Optional when this MCP connection sends it as the Authorization: Bearer header.

idempotency_key.description: Only to REPEAT an earlier call of this tool (a lost answer, a payment still confirming): the idempotency_key that call returned. Leave it out for a new call; the server then makes a random one and returns it.

bid_usd.description: Decimal string. Defaults to the minimum.

product.description: The ad format. Fields, limits and prices: GET /api/v1/formats.

total_budget_usd.description: The most the ad can spend, and the price.

payment_signature.description: The x402 PaymentPayload for the requirement an earlier call of this tool returned, as base64-encoded JSON (the value of an HTTP PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). An x402-aware MCP client sends the payload in _meta["x402/payment"] instead and leaves this out.

name: create_ad
title: Place an ad
